title: Utility Line Protection Plans: Slab Cutting Callout Amounts on Emergency Requests
content:
# Slab Cutting Callout Amounts on Emergency Requests

Field operations note, Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans, slab access on interior lines.

## Rule

Concrete cutting crews called out on the day an active leak is reported charge an emergency callout premium, and a crew called out the next day for a leak that is still running charges a smaller emergency premium. Slab cutting addition: an emergency request whose first contractor assignment was made on the request date adds the same-day slab cutting addition; an emergency request whose first contractor assignment was made on a later day adds the next-day slab cutting addition; every other request adds no slab cutting addition. The slab cutting addition is added to the slab access figure as a flat dollar amount.

## Amounts

| Urgency of the request | First contractor assignment (dispatch sequence 1) | Slab cutting addition |
|---|---|---|
| emergency | made on the request date | $200.00 (same-day) |
| emergency | made on a later day | $100.00 (next-day) |
| emergency | none made | none |
| routine | any | none |

## Reading the records

- The urgency is the one recorded on the service request.
- The first assignment is the contractor assignment numbered 1 on that service request; its date is compared with the request date.

## Hypothetical examples

- Emergency request placed on 3 February, first assignment on 3 February: $200.00 is added.
- Emergency request placed on 3 February, first assignment on 4 February: $100.00 is added.
- Routine request, first assignment the same day: nothing is added.
